name: AXIS IP Camera
description: The Axis IP Camera Orchestrator Extension is used to inventory, manage Trust certs, and enroll for client certificates that can be bound to endpoints.
short_description: The Axis IP Camera Orchestrator Extension is used to inventory, manage Trust certs, and enroll for client certificates that can be bound to endpoints.

store_types.Name: Axis IP Camera

Properties.Name: ServerUsername
Properties.Description: Enter the username of the configured "service" user on the camera

Properties.Name: ServerPassword
Properties.Description: Enter the password of the configured "service" user on the camera

Properties.Name: ServerUseSsl
Properties.Description: Select True or False depending on if SSL (HTTPS) should be used to communicate with the camera.

Properties.Name: BypassTlsValidation
Properties.Description: If true and 'Use SSL' is enabled, TLS certificate validation is skipped when connecting to the camera. Has no effect when 'Use SSL' is false. Only enable this when the camera's certificate cannot be trusted by the orchestrator server.

Properties.Name: HttpPort
Properties.Description: Optional. Port used to connect to the camera over HTTP, when 'Use SSL' is false. A port set here replaces any port in Client Machine. If blank, the port in Client Machine is used, or the default HTTP port (80) if Client Machine has no port.

Properties.Name: HttpsPort
Properties.Description: Optional. Port used to connect to the camera over HTTPS, when 'Use SSL' is true. A port set here replaces any port in Client Machine. If blank, the port in Client Machine is used, or the default HTTPS port (443) if Client Machine has no port.

EntryParameters.Name: CertUsage
EntryParameters.Description: The Certificate Usage to assign to the cert after enrollment. Can be left 'Other' to be assigned later.

store_types.ClientMachineDescription: The IP address of the Camera. Sample is "192.167.231.174:44444". Include the port if necessary.
store_types.StorePathDescription: Enter the Serial Number of the camera e.g. `0b7c3d2f9e8a`
